summary: National Registry-certified Paramedic with over 10 years of continuous experience in 911 emergency response, critical care transport, and field training. Recognized for calm decision-making under pressure and for mentoring new EMTs at a well-established local employer.

experience.title: Paramedic
bullets: Provide advanced life support on 911 responses, performing patient assessments, cardiac monitoring, IV and medication administration, and airway management for 1,200+ calls per year.
Serve as field training officer for 8 newly hired EMTs and paramedics, leading orientation, skills verification, and ride-along evaluations.
Collaborate with fire and law enforcement crews on multi-agency scenes, maintaining clear radio communication and incident documentation.
Maintain and restock advanced equipment and controlled medications, keeping unit readiness above 98% on quarterly audits.

experience.title: Paramedic
experience.employer: a regional emergency medical services provider
bullets: Delivered emergency and interfacility critical care transport as part of a two-person ALS crew across a multi-county service area.
Triaged and treated patients during high-volume shifts, prioritizing care based on acuity and coordinating handoff reports with receiving emergency departments.
Documented patient care electronically in compliance with state and insurance requirements, reducing chart return rates through careful review.
Trained incoming EMTs on stretcher operations, splinting, oxygen delivery, and safe ambulance driving procedures.

experience.title: EMT
bullets: Responded to basic life support calls, providing CPR, bleeding control, immobilization, oxygen therapy, and safe patient transport.
Assisted paramedics with advanced procedures, equipment setup, and lifting and moving patients with proper body mechanics.
Completed daily vehicle checks, infection control, and inventory of supplies to ensure unit readiness at shift start.
Communicated with dispatchers and receiving facilities to relay patient condition and transport status.

education.institution: National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians
